blocks.text: Zscaler allows for granular control of the authentication timeout on a per-location basis. You can create and manage custom authentication profiles on this page. To learn more, see Configuring Custom Authentication Timeout Profiles.
This feature is in limited availability. To access this feature, contact your Zscaler Account team.
Authentication profiles provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Control the authentication timeout in your organization on a per-location basis.
Manage up to 8 profiles with a frequency range of 5 minutes to 999 days.

blocks.text: The Authentication Profiles page is unavailable if you're subscribed to the Authentication Service. To learn more, see What Is Authentication Service?
On the Authentication Profiles page (Administration > Internet & SaaS Authentication > Internet Authentication Settings > Authentication Profiles), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Search for a previously configured authentication profile.
View a list of all authentication profiles configured for your organization. For each profile, you can see the following details:
Name: The name of the authentication profile.

Authentication Frequency: The amount of time that passes before users are forced to authenticate. The minimum frequency is 5 minutes and the maximum is 999 days. Zscaler recommends a frequency of at least 30 minutes for the best user experience.
